test.// inputs: INFRA-3228. The first four entries re-state targetDefaults.test verbatim: a target-level `inputs` REPLACES the targetDefaults value (nx merges targets with a plain spread, not a concat), so omitting them would silently narrow the input set. The trailing workspaceRoot globs are the cross-package sources the recipes/animations tests compile — mycelium by relative path (`// nx-ignore-next-line`), ui via the `ui/src` alias — which nx cannot infer: tailwind has no workspace deps (mycelium depends on tailwind, not the reverse, so `^production` resolves to nothing) and `analyzeSourceFiles` is off. Without them a token added or removed on either side replays a cached green instead of failing the build. `packages/ui/src/**` is deliberately the whole tree, not `theme/**` + `env.d.ts`: the animations curve test resolves the legacy driver configs through the `ui/src` BARREL, so a narrower glob leaves the barrel out of the hash and dropping the re-export replays green when it shouldn't (measured). An `implicitDependencies` edge tailwind -> mycelium would also fix the hash, but it puts a real cycle in the project graph (nx tolerates it silently today) and widens invalidation for every tailwind target.
